description: Candidates whose question compares a number with a threshold ("more than a month?", "less than 200 miles?"). In the level-0 pre-screen 5 of these 20 failed, against 2 of the other 150, mostly by flipping yes/no while explaining correctly. Not a filter: the §4 report shows lie rates with and without them (spec §11, 2026-10-23).
